scripts.test: pnpm test:quint && pnpm verify:quint && vitest run
scripts.test:quint: quint typecheck ../frontend/specs/puzzle.qnt && quint typecheck ../frontend/specs/puzzle_test.qnt && quint typecheck ../frontend/specs/solver_proof.qnt && quint test ../frontend/specs/puzzle_test.qnt --main puzzle_test
scripts.verify:quint: quint verify ../frontend/specs/puzzle.qnt --invariant puzzleInvariant --max-steps 12 && quint verify ../frontend/specs/solver_proof.qnt --main solver_proof --init solverInit --step solverStep --invariant distanceIsExact --max-steps 1
